card.name: Words just before a named website or organization
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, the, from, at) or 'www' right before the name of a website, institution or organization, mostly in web-page footers and source credits.

modes.label: Link word before a site name
modes.description: A preposition or 'the' that comes right before a named website or publication.
modes.example: Get more exposure for your case study by uploading it<< to>> the Consulting-Specifying Engineer case study

modes.label: Start of a web address
modes.description: 'www' or a dot piece in a URL, just before the domain name.
modes.example: The contents of this article is licensed from<< www>>.wikipedia.org under the GNU Free Documentation License

card.plain: It fires on the small word or web-address start that comes just before the name of a website or organization being cited.
